item.title: REPORT | Charlton Athletic 0-1 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Wrexham AFC claimed a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Charlton Athletic at the Valley after Ollie Rathbone’s first-half volley. Not much separated the two sides in the opening exchanges until Rathbone popped up with a moment of magic to score his seventh goal of the season after 30 minutes. Charlton battled hard to try and find an equaliser, with the game finely poised heading into the closing stages. item.title: PHIL PARKINSON | “We showed incredible resilience to get the win”
item.description: Wrexham AFC manager Phil Parkinson heralded his side’s backs-to-the-wall defensive effort to see out victory away to Charlton Athletic.
